Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

Imported border coordinates remain unchanged. Historical events and map coverage are distinguished in prose; see batchIdentityNotes for conflicts.

proposedOverrides.summary: Atlas-audited Travancore politics, daily life, reform, achievement, human costs, and continuity from 1800 to 1878.

batchIdentityNotes: Travancore was a historical monarchy, but its two atlas polygons are simplified and change substantially at the 1815 internal seam.
The 1800 atlas shore excludes several historically Travancore coastal places, so coastline and frontier detail must not be treated as exact.
The 1783 feature id netherlands carries the label Travancore at southern probes; this metadata conflict is not evidence of Dutch sovereignty.
The 1878 replacement by british-raj is a false state-ending seam. Travancore continued as a princely state until joining Cochin in 1949.
Court, mission, census, and state sources preserve unequal viewpoints; none is projected across all castes, classes, genders, faiths, languages, or localities.
Matriliny is not equated with matriarchy, and slavery, caste restrictions, upper-cloth violence, or coerced labor are never romanticized.
